response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with strong systems and web development skills, but their profile diverges significantly from this role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a bachelor thesis project; their recent decade has focused on TypeScript/Node.js web platforms and DLang. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL exposure, MQTT, message brokers in an industrial context, or automation/OT protocol experience, making them a weak fit for a senior C++ industrial-automation position despite otherwise impressive breadth.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience, exceeding the seniority bar
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal recent C++/STL experience — last professional C++ role ended in 2015
No industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 background evident
No IoT/MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP 3.0), or automation domain exposure

key_factors.factor: No industrial automation or IEC 62443 security experience
Strong general seniority and high-performance systems background
